cursorPerformanceManagementPlan.title: Cursor Performance Management Implementation Plan
cursorPerformanceManagementPlan.author: Claude 3.7 Sonnet
cursorPerformanceManagementPlan.executiveSummary: We've implemented a complete solution for diagnosing and resolving persistent Cursor IDE performance issues. The approach combines immediate relief through selective process termination with a systematic 7-day plan to address root causes. Our solution includes specialized diagnostic tools, comprehensive documentation, and preventive measures to ensure long-term stability.
